project.title: Warehouse Loading Bay Safety and Efficiency Upgrade
project.objective: Standardise loading, stacking and cleaning routines to reduce incidents and speed up truck turnaround in the warehouse loading bay.
deliverables: Standard operating procedure for loading and unloading trucks
Stacking and weight distribution guideline for pallets and containers
Daily cleaning and inspection checklist for loading bay and equipment
Revised loading sequence plan for typical routes and cargo types
Training walk-through and on-the-job coaching sessions for all shifts
constraints: All changes must be implementable without stopping operations
Procedures must comply with internal safety rules and cargo regulations
Forklift and lifting equipment usage limits must be respected
Documentation must be simple enough for quick reference on the floor
Pilot must be completed within one month including feedback round

risks.risk: Workers ignore new loading and cleaning procedures under time pressure.
risks.mitigation: Create short, visible checklists and get supervisor support to enforce during first weeks.

risks.risk: New stacking rules slow down loading and increase truck waiting time.
risks.mitigation: Pilot on one dock, measure turnaround, and adjust rules where they add no safety benefit.

risks.risk: Misunderstanding of weight limits and pictograms on lifting equipment.
risks.mitigation: Include pictogram examples in guideline and do quick toolbox talks at shift start.

risks.risk: Equipment downtime during inspections disrupts loading schedule.
risks.mitigation: Plan inspections during low-activity windows and coordinate with maintenance technician.

themes.why_relevant: Core to movers' daily work and key to reducing incidents and damage.
Participants handle heavy loads and must respect equipment capacity and cargo stability.
Clean surfaces and clear aisles reduce slips, trips and blocked exits.
Loading sequence and route plans affect how goods are staged and moved.
New procedures only work if explained clearly and reinforced on the floor.

backlog.task: Map current loading and unloading steps for typical truck arrivals
definition_of_done: List of current steps for at least three common load types documented
Bottlenecks and unsafe shortcuts identified
Shared with team for confirmation

backlog.task: Draft standard operating procedure for loading and unloading trucks
definition_of_done: SOP draft covers pre-checks, loading, unloading and post-checks
Includes forklift and crane usage notes
Reviewed by at least one factory hand for clarity

backlog.task: Create stacking and weight distribution guideline for pallets and containers
definition_of_done: Guideline lists max layers and weight per pallet type
Includes examples for mixed loads and dangerous goods pictograms
Validated with warehouse supervisor

backlog.task: Design daily cleaning and inspection checklist for loading bay
definition_of_done: Checklist covers floors, ramps, equipment and emergency exits
Tasks split by shift with estimated time per item
Printed version ready for use on clipboards

backlog.task: Propose improved loading sequence for main delivery routes
definition_of_done: For at least two main routes, loading order is defined by drop-off sequence
Plan considers cargo access and weight balance
Shared with logistics planner for feedback

backlog.task: Identify and mark high-risk zones in the loading bay
definition_of_done: High-traffic and blind-spot areas listed
Proposal for floor markings or signs prepared
Safety officer feedback captured

backlog.task: Run pilot of new SOP and checklists on one dock for one week
definition_of_done: Pilot dock selected and informed
New SOP and checklists used on all shifts for one week
Issues and suggestions logged daily

backlog.task: Collect feedback from movers and drivers on new procedures
definition_of_done: At least five movers and three drivers interviewed
Feedback grouped into positives, issues and ideas
Summary posted in channel

backlog.task: Adjust procedures based on pilot feedback and incidents log
definition_of_done: Pilot feedback and any incidents reviewed
SOP, guideline and checklist updated where needed
Version numbers and change notes recorded

backlog.task: Prepare quick training walk-through for each shift
definition_of_done: Short script for 15-minute walk-through created
Key do's and don'ts listed with examples
Training schedule agreed with supervisor

backlog.task: Set up simple tracking of checklist completion and issues
definition_of_done: Tracking sheet or board created for all shifts
Columns for date, shift, completed items and issues added
Team knows where and how to record data

backlog.task: Document handling rules for special loads such as animals or dangerous goods
definition_of_done: List of special load types relevant to site created
Key handling and loading rules summarised per type
Aligned with existing regulations and pictograms

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current loading, stacking and cleaning practices and main pain points.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking everyone to describe how loading and cleaning are done today.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree which load types and routes to focus on first for the new procedures.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review and finalise the draft SOP and stacking guideline before pilot.
threads_plan.trigger: Mover shares first version of SOP and stacking rules for comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the loading and unloading SOP draft for pilot use.
Confirm stacking and weight distribution rules to apply during pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define cleaning and inspection routines and how they will be tracked.
threads_plan.trigger: Factory hand posts proposal for new cleaning checklist and tracking sheet.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve daily cleaning and inspection checklist content.
Decide how and where checklist completion will be recorded each shift.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and coordinate the one-week pilot on a selected dock.
threads_plan.trigger: Message proposing pilot dock, dates and shifts for testing new procedures.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select which dock and shifts will run the pilot.
Agree on how issues and incidents will be logged during the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot results, adjust documents and lock in training plan.
threads_plan.trigger: Post summarising pilot week with key findings and asking for final comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve final versions of SOP, guidelines and checklists and training schedule.

channel_rituals: Daily short async check-in at shift change on any loading bay issues or near-misses.
Mid-week update on pilot progress and quick adjustments needed.
Weekly summary of checklist completion and main observations.
Post-pilot review session to capture lessons learned and confirm final procedures.
